H1_category_robustness.statement: DINOv2 positive utility is not driven by a single category.

H2_safety_robustness.statement: DINOv2 satisfies mean dFNR <= +0.02 under reasonable resampling / category perturbation.
H2_safety_robustness.evidence: LOO audit + confirmatory bootstrap (Stages B, D)

H3_few_normal_robustness.statement: K8 results retain the principal utility/safety relative to FULL.

H4_repeat_robustness.statement: K8 results are not driven by a few support realizations.

H5_selectivity_necessity.statement: The frozen gated policy keeps a clear safety advantage over its frozen Always-On counterpart.
H5_selectivity_necessity.evidence: paired comparison Gated vs Always-On (Stage D)

H6_detector_dependence.statement: DINOv2 vs PatchCore/EfficientAD differences persist under confirmatory analysis.

H7_no_single_category_failure_invalidate.statement: Removing any single category does not systematically flip the DINOv2 overall conclusion.
